msm_stage3_configuration.target: native label 1 versus stable cutting labels 0 and 2
msm_stage3_configuration.label2_sensitivity: exclude; rerun entire split/fitting pipeline with same declared seeds and gates

visual.geometry: source SAR 3:8; aspect-preserving centered black letterbox to 640x640
visual.pooling: spatial mean last three maps -> 896; temporal mean of 16
visual.precision: FP32 CNN extraction, FP32 head fitting

sensor.classifier: training-only standardization; balanced L2 logistic regression C=1, lbfgs max_iter=2000

fusion.calibration: none; evaluate calibration rather than fit on scarce groups

msm_stage3_configuration.model_selection: No search, early stopping, validation-based epoch choice, seed selection, or threshold tuning. Fixed final epoch. Inner validation creates OOF probabilities only.
msm_stage3_configuration.primary_metric: pooled held-out interval average precision; fusion minus each unimodal baseline paired by group

smoke.selection: first 8 admitted VM20i/d1; first 6 d4; first 6 VMX/d8; first 2 normal and first 2 abnormal VMX/d9

visual.geometry: source SAR 3:8; aspect-preserving centered black letterbox to 640x640
visual.pooling: spatial mean last three maps -> 896; temporal mean of 16
visual.precision: FP32 CNN extraction, FP32 head fitting

sensor.classifier: balanced L2 logistic C1 lbfgs max_iter2000; training-only standardization

quality_gate.implementation: reassemble.section2_models.DecisionGate (original quality-only F5 gate); new dataset context adapter
quality_gate.sensor_quality: per-channel log1p population std and explicit missing fraction, numerical channels only
quality_gate.context: training-only standardized quality plus two availability flags; no action/direction/participant/robot metadata
quality_gate.QG_aug: clean plus lowest-severity OOF corruptions; fixed epochs, no assessment selection
quality_gate.F2_aug: exposure-matched augmentation control; original F2 remains clean-OOF only
quality_gate.augmentation_weights: clean 0.5; seven lowest-severity nonmissing corruption views share 0.5

corruptions.video_policy: real RGB pixels within the resized image content, before CNN, padding unchanged; all severities fixed
corruptions.sensor_noise_policy: noise added to actual interval measurements, using pooled RAW training-partition channel SD; recompute fixed statistics
corruptions.channel_dropout_policy: deterministically chosen channels become all zero measurements; recompute statistics
corruptions.missing_channels_policy: explicitly missing channels; replace their statistics with CLEAN training-partition feature means; masks sent only to gate
corruptions.frame_dropout_policy: omit deterministic native frames; pool the retained cached per-frame embeddings (exact frozen-CNN equivalence)
corruptions.missing_modality_policy: unavailable unimodal predictions are NA; average/F2/gates use explicitly named deterministic available-branch fallback; no fabricated branch probability

model_selection: fixed final epoch; no search, early stopping, calibrator or test-dependent threshold

bootstrap.cluster: group, paired model differences; average seeds descriptively, not independent observations

architectural_claims: architecture portability and learned-weight transfer are separate; no fine optical anomaly visibility assumed
primary_target: 0 success, 1 any native nonzero failure outcome
sensor_contract: 36 channel-major statistics from exact source-verified official 6D aligned wrench; robot-specific gripper joints are omitted
alignment_gate: exact provided nearest-source resampling, max timing gap <=.1s, ordered native video/frame timestamps and content hashes
validation_use: predeclared fixed settings; report separately, no selection or refit using validation
participant_oof_gate: No explicit participant-to-trial mapping in official native metadata or author code; no trial-number/face grouping is invented.
independent_inference_limitation: Participant-level CIs unavailable; reported trial-bootstrap CIs, if any, are explicitly exploratory. Primary model differences remain paired point estimates.
